TBF Weeks

Source: R/tbf.R
tbf_weeks.Rd

The weeks (rounds) of one league-season, playoff rounds included.

Endpoint: GET https://miniappapi.tbf.org.tr/webapi-service/api/League/get-league-weeks

Usage

tbf_weeks(season, competition = "bsl")

Arguments

season

Required. Season END year (2027 = the 2026-2027 season). TBF keys a league-season by internal season and activity ids; the runtime reads them from the league's season list by the END year of the label. A year the list lacks raises hoopR_no_data.

competition

TBF league: bsl (Basketbol Super Ligi), tbl (second tier) or kbsl (women's Super Ligi). The top flight was named TBL until 2007-08 and is listed under bsl.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble. One row per week in play order; week is the value the schedule and standings take. Every column below is always present (a zero-row tibble keeps them and their types); an answer with nothing in it raises hoopR_no_data, as in sdv-py.

col_nametypedescription
activity_idintegerActivity id of the request's league-season (key space: TBF league-seasons).
seasonintegerSeason END year of the request (2027 = 2026-2027).
competitioncharacterTBF league of the request: bsl, tbl or kbsl.
weekcharacterWeek number as a string; the value the week argument of tbf_standings and tbf_schedule takes.
phaseintegerPhase code (devre = half / phase): 1 = first half of the regular season, 2 = second half, 3 = playoff quarter-final, 4 = semi-final, 5 = final.
phase_namecharacterPhase name in Turkish on playoff weeks (Playoff Final = final); null on regular-season weeks.
labelcharacterWeek label: 'Hafta N' (week N) or the playoff round name.
is_currentlogicalTrue on the current (or last played) week; exactly one row.

Details

Official TBF app API, unofficial for SportsDataverse: the backend of the Turkish Basketball Federation's mobile app (miniappapi.tbf.org.tr), which serves BSL, TBL, KBSL and the other TBF leagues. It needs no key; robots.txt answers 404 on the host, and the runtime spaces requests at least 1 s apart. SportsDataverse has not ruled on TBF's terms, so payloads are not redistributed as release assets. The vendor's origin hosts (nikayazilim.com) serve the same data without Cloudflare but are deliberately not used, redirects are never followed, and www.tbf.org.tr's interactive Turnstile is neither used nor automated.

Coverage: season and competition are parameters (bsl Basketbol Super Ligi, back to 1966-67 in the league list; tbl second tier; kbsl women, both from 2015-16). Game wrappers serve FINISHED games only (an unfinished game raises hoopR_asset_fetch). Box scores exist from 2006-07 (no starters flagged that season); play-by-play and shots from 2025-26 only, an earlier finished game raises hoopR_no_data. Every game carries a Genius LiveStats id (genius_id, joins the genius family) from 2018-19 on some seasons and on every game of 2025-26 and later. Birth dates, contact details, photos and logos are dropped. Names and category labels are Turkish; the column descriptions give the English gloss.

Errors: hoopR_no_data when TBF has nothing for the request (HTTP 404, an unknown game or player, a season the league list lacks, an empty list, a finished game before 2025-26 asked for play-by-play or shots); hoopR_bad_request for an invalid argument or HTTP 400 / 422; hoopR_asset_fetch when the fetch failed or the answer is not the one asked for (an unfinished game, a body for another game, season, league or team, an error envelope, a redirect, a partial page or a changed capped list). All inherit hoopR_error. Timestamps are Turkey local time (Europe/Istanbul).

See also

Other TBF: tbf_daily_matches(), tbf_game_header(), tbf_game_leaders(), tbf_game_players(), tbf_highlights(), tbf_leaders_assists(), tbf_leaders_blocks(), tbf_leaders_efficiency(), tbf_leaders_minutes(), tbf_leaders_points(), tbf_leaders_rebounds(), tbf_leaders_steals(), tbf_leaders_threes(), tbf_leaders_turnovers(), tbf_league_seasons(), tbf_leagues(), tbf_pbp(), tbf_period_scores(), tbf_player_box(), tbf_player_career(), tbf_players(), tbf_schedule(), tbf_seasons(), tbf_shots(), tbf_standings(), tbf_team_box(), tbf_team_games(), tbf_team_player_stats(), tbf_team_roster(), tbf_team_staff(), tbf_teams()
